reviews.text: The formula feels like a lip gloss and oil hybrid and is one of the most nourishing tints I’ve tried. I usually apply one layer and the gloss lasts about two hours and will apply a regular lip oil or balm until the stain wears off. 20 peach skin has a more beige orange color than what appears in the swatches.
reviews.zh: 質地感覺似唇彩同唇油混合，係我試過最滋潤嘅唇釉之一。我通常會塗一層，光澤大概維持兩個鐘，之後就會用返普通唇油或者潤唇膏直到染唇效果退晒。20 peach skin 嘅顏色比起試色圖偏向米橙調。

reviews.text: It's a nice sheer tint. It doesn't look like the same color on my lips as it does online but I expected that because I have a darker skin tone. I haven't tried doing more layers but I like the color payoff and the texture. My lips feel moisturized. I would try a different shade.
reviews.zh: 係唔錯嘅通透唇釉。塗上嘴嘅顏色同網上睇到嘅唔太一樣，不過因為我膚色較深，所以早有心理準備。我未試過疊加多層，但係鍾意佢嘅顯色度同質地。嘴唇感覺有保濕。會想試吓其他色號。

reviews.text: Love the peachy scent - the application is easy too, and it isn't sticky. It does finish at a deeper shade on the lips - a lovely light MLBB shade. Still a very natural shade.
reviews.zh: 鍾意桃味香氣——塗抹都好順，而且唔黏笠。喺嘴唇上呈現出嚟會深一啲，係好靚嘅淺色MLBB色號。仍然係好自然嘅顏色。

reviews.text: カラーが思ったより暗かったですがブルベには馴染む色で意外と大丈夫でした。テクスチャーはすごく好みかと言われるとそうではないようです。。
reviews.zh: 顏色比預期深，不過對冷調膚色嚟講幾夾，意外地冇問題。講到質地係唔係好啱我心水，似乎就唔係喇。。

reviews.text: Very pretty color and the formula is nice and thin however it does have a slightly oily feeling when you rub your lips together. I don’t really mind it though. Shade 23 is a prettt MLBB lip color suited for most skin tones
reviews.zh: 顏色好靚，質地都唔錯好輕薄，不過搓嘴嘅時候會有少少油笠嘅感覺。不過我其實唔太介意。23色號係好靚嘅MLBB唇色，適合大部分膚色。

reviews.shade: [SET] 17 Sugar Angel (+Mini Tint M03 Coral Sugar)
reviews.text: love the color payoff, long lasting and feels great on my lips! the only thing is that the aftertaste is a bit weird (i swear I’m not just licking the lipstick but sometimes I unconsciously do it and i can taste it 😭😭)
reviews.zh: 鍾意佢嘅顯色度，持久同埋搽上嘴好舒服！唯一嘅問題就係有陣怪怪嘅餘味（我發誓我唔係特登去舐唇膏，但有時唔覺意就會，然後就食到個味😭😭）

reviews.text: Bought this in a super sale set with a eyeshadow palette, cheek palette, and lip tint that came with a free mini souffle pot, lip applicator and keychain! The tint feels very hydrating and it smells super good, kinda like apricots. The colour is also really nice and lasts quite a while.
reviews.zh: 喺特價套裝入面買嘅，入面有眼影盤、胭脂盤同唇釉，仲送咗迷你舒芙蕾罐、唇掃同鎖匙扣！唇釉保濕度好高，味道好香，有啲似杏脯。顏色都好靚，持久度都幾好。

reviews.text: This has become my new daily lip product since trying it. The formula feels like a lip gloss and oil hybrid and is one of the most moisturizing tints I’ve tried. I usually apply one layer and the gloss lasts about two hours and will apply a regular lip oil or balm until the stain wears off. The lighter colors are great for people with muted tones.
reviews.zh: 自從試咗之後，呢個已經變咗我嘅日常唇妝新寵。質地感覺似唇彩同唇油混合，係我試過最保濕嘅唇釉之一。我通常會塗一層，光澤大概維持兩個鐘，之後就會用返普通唇油或者潤唇膏直到染唇效果退晒。淺色嗰啲色號對低飽和度色調嘅人好啱。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
